whyItHelps.zh-Hant: 與 Git 緊密整合的開源翻譯平台，譯文連同譯者署名 commit 回 repo，資料存放在歐盟。

whyItHelps.en: An open source, Git-integrated translation platform that commits translations back with attribution; data stays in the EU.
